description: Clear the values in a range, leaving the tab and its formatting in place. This is the non-destructive way to empty a tab or a block of cells — use it instead of deleting and recreating a tab, which throws away the tab's structure along with its data.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

range.description: Range to clear in A1 notation. A bare tab name clears the whole tab (e.g. "Inventory"), or clear a block with "Inventory!A2:D"

name: gws-mcp__sheets_clear
